description: This file contains unit test templates and test cases for the ClientCertStore component in the net namespace, focusing on client certificate filtering behavior in SSL/TLS contexts.

classes.name: ClientCertStoreTest
classes.description: A templated test class for testing platform-specific implementations of ClientCertStore, providing common test cases for client certificate filtering.

methods.name: EmptyQuery
methods.description: Test case verifying that an empty certificate list results in no selected identities.

methods.name: AllIssuersAllowed
methods.description: Test case verifying that a CertRequestInfo with no specified authorities matches all certificates.

methods.name: CertAuthorityFiltering
methods.description: Test case verifying filtering of certificates based on specified certificate authorities.

methods.name: PrintableStringContainingUTF8
methods.description: Test case verifying handling of certificates with UTF-8 strings in subject fields.
